_**User**_

Write spec/api-contract.md for the Support Ticket REST API.

No implementation.

Cover request/response shapes, HTTP methods, paths, status codes, and error bodies for:
- Create ticket
- List tickets
- Get ticket details
- Update title, description, priority, assignee
- Add comment
- Search by keyword
- Filter by status
- Status transition (if separate from update; if combined, specify exactly how status is changed)

Rules:
- Follow the project's API standards steering file.
- Backend validation failures must return a machine-readable + human-readable error the UI can display.
- Invalid status transitions must be rejected (4xx), not silently coerced.
- Document query parameters for search and status filter.
- Document idempotency/concurrency only if you choose a simple rule (e.g. last-write-wins) and state it.

Keep the contract small enough to implement in a take-home, complete enough that frontend and tests can be written against it.

Ready to draft the full API contract.

Decided on base path `/api`, camelCase JSON, and UUID string IDs. Priority is optional on create, defaulting to MEDIUM.

Status changes will use a dedicated endpoint rather than being mixed with field updates. Invalid transitions will return 422 Unprocessable Entity.

Pagination follows the API standards envelope. Search uses a `q` parameter for case-insensitive title and description matching. Status filtering uses a `status` query parameter. Concurrency follows last-write-wins. PATCH leaves omitted fields unchanged and null clears the assignee. Create requires title and description. Priority defaults to MEDIUM. Assignee is optional. Status is always OPEN and cannot be set by the client.
</details></think>

_**Agent (auto-smart)**_

Wrote **`spec/api-contract.md`** — contract only, no code.

### What it covers
- **Create** `POST /api/tickets` — status always `OPEN` (client `status` rejected)
- **List / search / filter** `GET /api/tickets` — `q`, `status`, pagination
- **Detail** `GET /api/tickets/{id}` — includes comments
- **Field update** `PATCH /api/tickets/{id}` — title, description, priority, assignee (merge; no status)
- **Status change** `POST /api/tickets/{id}/transition` — separate from PATCH; illegal transitions → **`422` + `INVALID_TRANSITION`**
- **Add comment** `POST /api/tickets/{id}/comments`

### Alignment with standards
- Error body matches `rules/api-standards.md` (`code` + `message` + optional `details`)
- Paged list envelope; camelCase JSON; `/api` prefix; last-write-wins

### Locked for implementability
Priority enum, UUID ids, search on title+description, unassign via `null`/`""`. Full allow/deny matrix stays in upcoming `spec/state-machine.md`.
